_comment: Illustrative example doll, hand-authored to show the schema. NOT engine output. The Sun as an astronomical body doll: canonical timed positions, computed aspect edges, an empty story layer ready for personal meaning. See ../SCHEMA.md.

body._note: Position is not stored here; it is time-dependent and lives in playthrough as measured-then facts.

wardrobe._note: Empty. A celestial body has no swappable per-scene appearance state in this model.

play._note: Affordances: anchors the orbital reference frame; emits light. Game-AI rules for the solar-system dollhouse live here.

catalog._note: Possibility space. For an astronomical body this is thin; for the Sun-as-symbol concept doll (a separate doll) the catalog would hold every meaning the symbol could carry.

edges._note: Aspects are typed company edges, pure functions of position at a timestamp. Recomputed, never guessed.

story._note: Empty and ready. Personal meaning of the Sun placement links here to MemPalace closet/drawer ids. Sovereign, never leaves the machine.

origin._note: Provenance is per facet. self/body/play/company above are canonical from astronomy sources (no VLM needed: the sky is already digitized). story is private, authored by the owner.

playthrough._note: A measured-then fact. True as measured at this instant. This is how an ephemeris becomes a playthrough; a natal chart is the playset frozen at a birth timestamp.
